workers.role: Re-verify and repair one phase-2 plan trio against master HEAD
workers.artifact: edited trio in place + a findings report (stale claims found, fixes applied, residual blockers)
acceptance: every cited src/ path exists or is marked (new)
every cited table/column/function/grant verified against schema.ts or drizzle/
each task has Files/Do/Verify with a real command

workers.note: different standard: its own Phase 0 reproduces its dangerous claims against a live PG18 cluster; verify the claims are still true of HEAD, do not soften the Phase 0 gate

acceptance: every new table has full column list, checks, indexes, composite FKs and per-role grants inline
each task is one reviewable unit of work with a runnable Verify
task count proportional to surface (>=28 for 4 tables + worker + billing + UI)

workers.note: must resolve the candidate_documents reuse blocker the orchestrator found
highest ethical risk; MVP must never submit externally

verification_strategy.mechanical_gate: orchestrator re-runs the link resolver, the src/**.test.ts scan, the hardcoded-migration-number scan, and the Files/Do/Verify shape check across all 14 trios after the wave returns
verification_strategy.judgement_gate: orchestrator reads each findings report and spot-checks the two highest-risk claims per plan against the codebase
verification_strategy.failure_policy: redispatch the same scope with the specific failing check named; hard cap 2 retries; after that report the gap rather than hide it

invariants_respected.2_clean_context: each prompt carries a verbatim ground-truth block; no orchestrator history
invariants_respected.4_no_worker_chatter: career-plan shared contract is pasted verbatim into all three wave-B prompts instead of letting them reconcile
invariants_respected.5_verification_gate: mechanical scans, not a vibes check
